subject: general
question: Indian National Congress celebrated the first Independence Day in Colonial India on _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26 January 1930**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian National Congress celebrated the first Independence Day in Colonial India on 26 January 1930.
 
• This date was chosen to commemorate the declaration of Purna Swaraj, meaning "complete self-rule" apart from British rule, which was declared on the same day in 1929.
 
• 26 January was later chosen as the Republic Day of India, marking the date in 1950 when the Constitution of India came into effect.
 
• The day was observed with meetings, demonstrations, and patriotic fervor across the country to demand Purna Swaraj or complete independence from British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Event

 
 
 
Description

 
 
 

 
 
Purna Swaraj Declaration

 
 
 
The formal proclamation of the declaration of independence from British rule, made by the Indian National Congress.

 
 
 

 
 
Republic Day

 
 
 
26 January was later designated as Republic Day, a national holiday in India, commemorating the day the Constitution of India came into effect.

 
 
 

 
 
Lahore Session

 
 
 
The Congress session held in Lahore in December 1929, where the resolution of Purna Swaraj was adopted.

 
 
 

 
 
Constitution of India

 
 
 
The governing document of India, which lays down the framework demarcating fundamental political code, structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions.
